patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in livestreams, and expanding the livestream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Colorize comment indent lines
patches_modified.description: Replaces the default gray comment indent lines with color-coded lines.
